<ins>Pig Bile Guiding Method (豬膽汁導法)</ins>
Take one large pig's gall bladder, pour out the juice and mix with a little method vinegar (法醋), and use it to irrigate the anus (穀道); within about a moment, there will be a bowel movement, and the retained food and evil matter will come out; it is very effective. <ins>Jade Candle Powder (玉燭散)</ins>
Raw rehmannia (生地黃), dang gui (當歸), chuanxiong (川芎), red peony (赤芍藥), rhubarb (大黃, soaked in wine), mirabilite (芒硝)
With the guiding herb fresh ginger (生薑), decoct in water and take. <ins>Four Substances Decoction (四物湯)</ins> and <ins>Supplementing the Middle and Benefiting Qi Decoction (補中益氣湯)</ins> (both are found under injury with bleeding, 傷損出血)
<ins>Six-Ingredient Rehmannia Pill (六味地黃丸)</ins> (the formula is found under pain in the muscles, 肌肉作痛)
